tsTitel.myworklog_kommt_in_den_play: MyWorkLog is coming to the Play Store.

tsLead.bevor_eine_neue_app_oeffentlich: Before a new app may appear publicly on Google Play, at least 12 people have to keep it installed for 14 days. That is where you come in: two clicks, free.

tsNurAndroid.du_bist_gerade_nicht_auf: You are not on Android right now. Open this page on an Android phone, it works in one go there:

tsSchritt1.mit_dem_googlekonto_das_auf: Use the Google account that is signed in to the Play Store on your phone. If you have several accounts, check the one in the top right corner.

tsSchritt2.auf_tester_werden_tippen_danach: Tap “Become a tester”, then install the app via the link to Google Play.

tsSchritt3.mehr_ist_es_nicht_danach: That is all. Afterwards you can keep the app or delete it again.

tsFragen.sieht_jemand_meine_emailadresse: Can anyone see my email address?
tsFragen.die_mitgliederliste_der_gruppe_sehe: Only I can see the group’s member list. Other testers cannot see you.
tsFragen.was_ist_das_fuer_eine: What kind of app is it?
tsFragen.dieselbe_wie_auf_myworklogde_zeiterfassu: The same as on myworklog.de: time tracking and a report book for apprentices, no account, your data stays on the device.
tsFragen.den_test_gibt_es_nur: The test is Android only. On the iPhone you use MyWorkLog in the browser and add it via “Add to Home Screen”.

__title: Become a tester — MyWorkLog on the Play Store
__metaDescription: MyWorkLog is coming to the Google Play Store as an Android app. Google needs 12 testers for 14 days first. Two steps and you are in.
